subject: English
title: 英文第3題｜臺灣狐蝠閱讀｜1970 年代的被動語態
question:
三、克漏字（每題2分，共12分）

請選第 3 空。

(A) are bought
(B) were caught
(C) will be sent
(D) have been kept
explanation:
most of them 的 them 指文章前面提到的 Formosan Flying Foxes（臺灣狐蝠）。依文意，牠們是被捕捉的一方，空格要用被動。in the 1970s 指明已結束的過去時段，複數 most of them 搭配 were。caught 是 catch 的過去分詞。were 可共同帶出 caught as pets 和 killed for their meat，兩者都是被動。

(A) are bought 是現在簡單式被動。(C) will be sent 是未來式被動。兩者都與 1970 年代衝突。(D) have been kept 是現在完成式被動，這裡已指定事件發生在 1970 年代，應用過去簡單式。本題依原文提供的時間與敘事解題。
trap: in the 1970s 鎖定已結束的過去時段。
verificationNote: 已直接核對原卷印刷文字、作答與紅筆。日期取本題首次提問的臺灣日期。考試日期與冊次未能確認。 已核對整篇文章。題庫收錄使用者指定的第 3 空，其他空的選項仍見原卷證據。
studentAnswer: 原卷圈選 (D) have been kept，紅筆訂正為 (B) were caught。
passage: ___1.___ you ever ___1.___ of Formosan Flying Foxes? They are not foxes; they are the largest bats in Taiwan. They feed on fruit and live in trees. In the past, they could only ___2.___ in zoos. That was because most of them ___3.___ as pets or killed for their meat in the 1970s. However, something exciting ___4.___ in 2009: over 20 of them ___5.___ on Turtle Island in Yilan. Don’t you think they need ___6.___ well if we want to see them flying again in the sky of Taiwan?
